title: Myths About Emsculpt NEO®
paragraphs: We live in a world where people care about how they look. Nobody can be blamed for it, as we all wish to embody our best selves, in looks but how we feel. It is often said that if you look good, you feel good. Your appearance does affect your overall personality. It might sound materialistic, but it is somewhat true. Days you feel fresh and look your best, you are more likely to find inner peace and happiness, or maybe the right word is content. However, if you do so, it is normal and doesn’t make you a self-absorbed person. Can you imagine not caring about how you look? It may be possible on some days; you are tired or sick. Overall, not having a perspective or a sense of your appearance is unimaginable! It usually starts from childhood and grows into adulthood, and society has much to contribute. You have family and friends around you to tell you that, and social media constantly reminds you of things you are missing. But everything you see is not real, so relax and be yourself!

Social media has significantly impacted our views or perspectives, whether positive or negative. There are preconceived notions that you fit in the society if you have a typical body or face and don’t otherwise. But on the good side, the conversation around body positivity has encouraged many men and women to build confidence in their bodies. It is about making a choice, as everyone has the right to live the way they wish. If you are comfortable, it’s all good, even if you don’t tick all the boxes. As long as you are comfortable and happy, it is great!

Meanwhile, some people wish to become active or healthy, irrespective of their size, and it is their choice. Several options are available for them, and one of them is body sculpting. Several myths circulate about treatment options like Emsculpt NEO®, and the following reasoning can help clear your mind.

Weight Loss Procedure – The treatment helps tone muscles, reduce pockets of fat, and contour the body. If you think it helps reduce your weight, then you are mistaken. It is effective for people with a Body Mass Index (BMI) of 30 or lower.

Ineffective Procedure – The studies show that patients can achieve optimal strengthening and toning with four Emsculpt NEO® sessions. It is more like your workout; you will achieve visible results in three to four sessions.

Side Effects – It is painless, and patients often relax while the devices work. There are hardly any side effects of the procedure. You may experience muscle soreness, redness, swelling, or bruising, but it is rare.
Costly – Emsculpt NEO® can help achieve the difference in a single application that other body contouring treatments can in numerous and expensive cycles.
